decisions.reason: Although it was no longer separately observed on the website by 2020-2021, this resin injection unit is core process equipment tied to the firm's announced innovation path, so management would be inclined to continue backing it rather than admit a failed launch.

This second resin injection unit also sits close to the firm's established injection and fluid-handling business, and the sunk development and launch commitment still favor persistence despite weaker recent visibility.

An automatic airless spray gun fits the firm's core spray-application offering so well that management would usually retain it, even if it has likely been folded into the broader portfolio rather than promoted as a stand-alone novelty.

Because the manual airless spray gun is highly central to the company's traditional product range, a medium-sized German machinery firm would normally keep supporting it unless there were unmistakable signs of technical or market failure.
As a product line with several models in a core application area, it reflects the strongest visible prior commitment and is therefore the least likely to be withdrawn quickly.

The data logger is more adjacent to the firm's mechanical core and, after several years without clear continued market visibility, management is more likely to stop it and redirect resources to core equipment and new developments.
